scenario_description:
Objective: Make the patio dinner more comfortable by adding a removable screen option before guests arrive.
Emerging Need: A free kit opportunity moves from unconfirmed to available, but the useful size and pickup logistics become time-bound.
Decision Context: Stored household notes identify the patio door size and lease-friendly screen limits; later messages supply a pickup volunteer and reservation deadline.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance merely leaves the household using the door as usual, while waiting past the cutoff forfeits this optional comfort upgrade.

parameter.title: Patio dinner with neighbors
parameter.description: Casual back-patio dinner; plan to keep the sliding door available for kitchen access and airflow.

parameter.content: When I was setting out the patio chairs last night, mosquitoes kept drifting into the kitchen whenever the slider stayed open. A removable screen would make tomorrow nicer, but keeping the door shut also works.

parameter.subject: Possible free patio screen kit pickup today
parameter.body: We may receive a limited batch of free removable magnetic patio screen kits from the summer airflow program. Inventory, sizes, and pickup rules will be posted after noon; early replies will not be counted.

parameter.subject: Free patio screen kits confirmed for Friday pickup
parameter.body: The kit batch has arrived. Available sizes are 32x80 and 36x80 removable magnetic panels. Reply to this email by 14:00 today with one size and a pickup name; confirmed pickups run 15:30-17:30 today. One kit per address.

parameter.content: I'm biking past Sunnyside Tool Library around 16:10 on my way home. If there's a pickup confirmation in my name before then, I'm fine grabbing a screen kit and leaving it by the patio door.

parameter.subject: Free patio screen kit reservations are closed
parameter.body: All Friday screen kit reservations closed at 14:00 and remaining kits have been assigned to submitted pickup names. There will be no walk-up distribution today; the next possible batch will be posted Monday.
